summary.formula: score = round(100 * sum(weight * credit) / sum(weight)) over the rules of a category that could be evaluated; credit: pass 1, warning 0.5, fail 0; weight by severity: critical 10, high 6, medium 3, low 1, info 0. unknown and not_applicable results are left out, so they never lower a score. coverage = evaluated weight / (evaluated + unknown weight); confidence = mean confidence of the evaluated rules, weighted the same way. There is no overall score.
summary.lab_tool: crawler 1.0.0: one request per page, no device or network emulation

findings.title: Text alternatives for images
findings.observed_value: 2 of 2 images have no alt attribute
findings.expected_condition: every image has an alt attribute (up to 10% missing is a warning)
findings.remediation: Describe meaningful images in alt text; give decorative ones alt="".
findings.commercial_relevance: Blind visitors and search engines cannot see images without alt text.

findings.title: Page language declared
findings.observed_value: the html element declares no language
findings.expected_condition: the html element of the home page declares its language
findings.remediation: Add lang="en" or lang="es" to the html element.
findings.commercial_relevance: Screen readers and translators need the language to read the page correctly.

findings.title: Questions and answers
findings.observed_value: no questions and answers on the analyzed pages
findings.expected_condition: an FAQ page, FAQPage data or at least three question headings
findings.remediation: Answer the questions customers ask, in text, on an FAQ or on the service pages.
findings.commercial_relevance: Question-and-answer content is what answer engines quote.

findings.title: Contact page
findings.observed_value: no contact page among the analyzed pages or their links
findings.expected_condition: a contact page is among the analyzed pages or linked from them
findings.remediation: Add a contact page with phone, email, a form and the address or area.
findings.commercial_relevance: It is where visitors who are ready to buy go first.

findings.title: Substantial home page content
findings.expected_condition: at least 250 words of main content on the home page (80 is a warning)
findings.remediation: Explain the services, the area, the credentials and the next step in text.
findings.commercial_relevance: Thin pages give visitors, search engines and assistants little to go on.

findings.title: Lead form
findings.observed_value: no contact, quote or booking form on the analyzed pages
findings.expected_condition: a contact, quote or booking form, or a form tool, is available
findings.remediation: Add a short contact or quote request form.
findings.commercial_relevance: Forms capture leads after hours and from people who prefer not to call.

findings.title: Trust signals
findings.observed_value: no reviews, licence, insurance, guarantee, portfolio or experience stated
findings.expected_condition: two or more kinds: reviews, rating, licence, insurance, guarantee, portfolio, experience
findings.remediation: Show reviews, licences, insurance, guarantees and real work.
findings.commercial_relevance: Trust signals turn a comparison visit into a call.

findings.title: Home page meta description
findings.observed_value: the home page has no meta description
findings.expected_condition: a description of 50 to 170 characters
findings.remediation: Summarize the offer, the area and the next step in one or two sentences.
findings.commercial_relevance: The description is the text under the search result and often decides the click.

findings.title: No mixed content
findings.expected_condition: https pages load no resource over http
findings.remediation: Load scripts, images, frames and stylesheets over https.
findings.commercial_relevance: Browsers block or flag insecure resources: broken images, forms and trust warnings.

findings.title: Main call to action
findings.expected_condition: a call, quote, booking or buy action in the header or as a button on the home page
findings.remediation: Put one clear action (call, request a quote, book) at the top of the home page.
findings.commercial_relevance: Without a visible next step, interested visitors leave without contacting the business.

findings.title: Home page title
findings.expected_condition: a title of 10 to 70 characters
findings.remediation: Write a title with the business name, its main service and its area.
findings.commercial_relevance: The title is the headline of the search result people click.

findings.title: About page
findings.observed_value: no about page among the analyzed pages or their links
findings.expected_condition: an about page is among the analyzed pages or linked from them
findings.remediation: Add an about page with the team, the history and the credentials.
findings.commercial_relevance: Visitors check who is behind a business before they trust it.

findings.title: Services page
findings.observed_value: no services page among the analyzed pages or their links
findings.expected_condition: a services page is among the analyzed pages or linked from them
findings.remediation: Describe every service on its own page or on a services page.
findings.commercial_relevance: Service pages match what people search for and explain the offer.

findings.title: Address or service area
findings.observed_value: no address or service area stated
findings.expected_condition: the site states an address or the area it serves
findings.remediation: Show the address, or the cities and areas served when the business travels to customers.
findings.commercial_relevance: Local search and customers both need to know where the business works.

findings.title: Complete business data
findings.expected_condition: the LocalBusiness data carries name, address and telephone
findings.remediation: Complete the missing LocalBusiness properties.
findings.commercial_relevance: Incomplete data is ignored or shown without the details that bring calls.

findings.title: Heading order
findings.expected_condition: no heading level is skipped on the home page
findings.remediation: Nest headings in order: H1, then H2, then H3.
findings.commercial_relevance: Screen reader users move through a page by its headings.

findings.title: Linked profiles
findings.observed_value: no links to the business's profiles elsewhere
findings.expected_condition: sameAs data or links to the business's profiles elsewhere
findings.remediation: Link the business's profiles (Google, Facebook, Yelp) and list them in sameAs.
findings.commercial_relevance: Assistants connect a site with the business through its profiles.

findings.title: Favicon
findings.observed_value: no icon is declared (a /favicon.ico may still be served)
findings.expected_condition: the home page declares an icon
findings.remediation: Add a favicon link.
findings.commercial_relevance: The icon identifies the business in tabs, bookmarks and some search results.

findings.title: Social sharing metadata
findings.expected_condition: og:title and og:image on the home page
findings.remediation: Add Open Graph title, description and image tags.
findings.commercial_relevance: Shared links then show a proper preview in social networks and messaging apps.

findings.title: Privacy policy
findings.observed_value: no privacy policy among the analyzed pages or their links
findings.expected_condition: a privacy policy is linked, above all where forms collect personal data
findings.remediation: Publish a privacy policy and link it from the footer and the forms.
findings.commercial_relevance: Forms without a privacy policy erode trust and may breach privacy law.

findings.title: Online booking or quote
findings.observed_value: no online booking or quote request
findings.expected_condition: a booking tool, or a quote or booking action or form, is offered
findings.remediation: Offer online booking or a quote request.
findings.commercial_relevance: Booking or asking for a price online captures leads without a call.

findings.title: Chat or messaging
findings.observed_value: not detected: no chat widget or messaging link
findings.expected_condition: a chat widget or a messaging link (WhatsApp, SMS, Messenger) is detected
findings.remediation: Offer a messaging channel, such as a WhatsApp link.
findings.commercial_relevance: Many customers prefer writing to calling.

findings.title: Contact in the navigation
findings.observed_value: no contact link or call button in the header or navigation
findings.expected_condition: the header or navigation links to contact or offers a call button
findings.remediation: Add a contact link or a call button to the header.
findings.commercial_relevance: Visitors look for contact options at the top of the page.

findings.title: Opening hours
findings.expected_condition: opening hours are stated on a page or in structured data
findings.remediation: Publish opening hours on the site and in structured data.
findings.commercial_relevance: People check the hours before they call or visit.

findings.title: Map or directions
findings.expected_condition: a map or directions are offered
findings.remediation: Embed a map or link to directions on the contact page.
findings.commercial_relevance: Directions turn a visit to the site into a visit to the business.

findings.title: Canonical URL
findings.observed_value: the home page declares no canonical URL
findings.expected_condition: the home page declares a canonical URL on its own site
findings.remediation: Add <link rel="canonical"> pointing at the preferred address of each page.
findings.commercial_relevance: Without it, duplicate addresses split ranking signals.

findings.title: No broken internal links
findings.observed_value: the crawl requested none of the linked pages
findings.expected_condition: links between pages lead to pages that answer
findings.remediation: Update or remove links to missing pages.
findings.commercial_relevance: Broken links end visits and waste the crawl budget of search engines.

findings.title: Signs of maintenance
findings.observed_value: no copyright year to judge by
findings.expected_condition: the newest copyright year is the crawl's year or the year before
findings.remediation: Keep the footer year and the content current.
findings.commercial_relevance: An outdated site suggests the business may have closed.

findings.title: XML sitemap
findings.expected_condition: a sitemap that lists URLs can be read
findings.remediation: Publish /sitemap.xml and declare it in robots.txt.
findings.commercial_relevance: Sitemaps help search engines find every service and location page.

findings.title: Compressed responses
findings.observed_value: no response headers of the home page to read
findings.expected_condition: the home page is served with gzip, Brotli, Zstandard or deflate
findings.remediation: Enable compression on the web server or CDN.
findings.commercial_relevance: Uncompressed HTML loads slower, especially on mobile networks.

findings.title: Advertising and call tracking
findings.observed_value: not detected: no advertising or call-tracking tag was seen, which does not show that the business does not advertise
findings.expected_condition: advertising pixels or call tracking are detected
findings.remediation: If the business advertises, install the conversion tags of each platform.
findings.commercial_relevance: Informational: not detecting a pixel does not show that the business does not advertise.

findings.title: Tag manager
findings.expected_condition: a tag manager is detected
findings.remediation: A tag manager is optional; it makes adding tracking easier.
findings.commercial_relevance: Informational: tags loaded inside a tag manager are invisible to this audit.

findings.title: Home page can be indexed
findings.observed_value: no noindex directive, and robots.txt allows the home page
findings.expected_condition: no noindex directive, and robots.txt allows the home page to search engines
findings.remediation: Remove noindex from the home page and allow it in robots.txt.
findings.commercial_relevance: A page search engines may not index cannot be found by people looking for the business.

findings.title: Content without JavaScript
findings.observed_value: 1 pages show their content without JavaScript
findings.expected_condition: pages show their content in the HTML, without running JavaScript
findings.remediation: Render the main content on the server, or pre-render the pages.
findings.commercial_relevance: Many search and AI assistant crawlers do not run JavaScript and see an empty page.

findings.title: Tap to call
findings.expected_condition: phone numbers are tel: links
findings.remediation: Wrap every phone number in a tel: link.
findings.commercial_relevance: Most local visits happen on phones: one tap turns a visit into a call.

findings.title: LocalBusiness structured data
findings.expected_condition: valid JSON-LD with a LocalBusiness type or subtype
findings.remediation: Add LocalBusiness JSON-LD (or a more specific type) with name, address, phone and hours.
findings.commercial_relevance: Structured data feeds local results, maps and assistants with the business facts.

findings.title: Phone number shown
findings.observed_value: a phone number on 1 of 1 pages
findings.expected_condition: a phone number appears on the site
findings.remediation: Show the business phone in the header or footer of every page.
findings.commercial_relevance: Local customers call: a phone they cannot find is a lost lead.

findings.title: Mobile viewport
findings.expected_condition: a viewport meta tag with width=device-width
findings.remediation: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">.
findings.commercial_relevance: Without it phones show a shrunken desktop page.

findings.title: Served over HTTPS
findings.expected_condition: the home page ends on an https address
findings.remediation: Install a TLS certificate and redirect every http address to https.
findings.commercial_relevance: Browsers label http pages 'Not secure', which turns visitors away before they call.

findings.title: Pages answer
findings.expected_condition: the crawled pages answer without errors (a failing home page or over 20% fail)
findings.remediation: Fix or redirect the pages that return errors, starting with the home page.
findings.commercial_relevance: An error page loses the visitor who reached it.

findings.title: AI crawlers allowed
findings.observed_value: robots.txt lets the crawlers of AI assistants read the site
findings.expected_condition: robots.txt does not block the crawlers of AI assistants
findings.remediation: Allow GPTBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and others to appear in AI answers.
findings.commercial_relevance: Blocked crawlers cannot learn about the business; blocking may be a deliberate choice.

findings.title: Valid structured data
findings.expected_condition: valid JSON-LD (or microdata) describing the business, its services or its FAQs
findings.remediation: Publish valid JSON-LD for the business, its services and FAQs; fix invalid blocks.
findings.commercial_relevance: Answer engines and assistants rely on structured facts to cite a business.

findings.title: Analytics
findings.expected_condition: an analytics tag is detected on the analyzed pages
findings.remediation: Install analytics (Google Analytics 4 or another) to measure visits and leads.
findings.commercial_relevance: Without measurement nobody knows which channels bring customers.

findings.title: Zoom allowed
findings.expected_condition: the viewport does not disable zooming
findings.remediation: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale=1 from the viewport.
findings.commercial_relevance: People who cannot zoom cannot read small text.

findings.title: One main heading
findings.expected_condition: exactly one H1 on the home page
findings.remediation: Use one H1 that says what the business does and where.
findings.commercial_relevance: The main heading tells visitors and search engines what the page is about.

findings.title: Stays on its own domain
findings.expected_condition: the home page does not send visitors to another domain
findings.remediation: If the business moved, point listings and ads at the new domain; else drop the redirect.
findings.commercial_relevance: Listings and ads pointing at an old domain waste visits and confuse search engines.

findings.title: Short redirect chain
findings.expected_condition: the home page answers after at most one redirect (two is a warning)
findings.remediation: Point links and the http and www variants straight to the final address.
findings.commercial_relevance: Every hop delays the first screen, on mobile networks most of all.

findings.title: Named links
findings.expected_condition: every link has text or an accessible name (up to 3 without is a warning)
findings.remediation: Give icon links an aria-label or visible text.
findings.commercial_relevance: Links without a name are announced as 'link' and cannot be understood.

findings.title: robots.txt
findings.expected_condition: robots.txt can be read
findings.remediation: Serve a robots.txt that allows the public pages and declares the sitemap.
findings.commercial_relevance: A robots.txt that errors can stop search engines from crawling the site at all.

findings.title: Lean home page HTML
findings.expected_condition: home page HTML of at most 500 KiB (1.5 MiB is a warning)
findings.remediation: Remove inline data, unused markup and embedded assets from the HTML.
findings.commercial_relevance: Heavy pages load slowly on phones and cost visitors data.

findings.title: Server response time (lab)
findings.observed_value: median 40 ms over 1 pages (lab: one crawler request each)
findings.expected_condition: a median crawler response of at most 800 ms (2 s is a warning)
findings.remediation: Use caching, a CDN or a faster host.
findings.commercial_relevance: Slow answers raise abandonment; a lab measurement, not what visitors experience.

findings.title: Labelled form fields
findings.expected_condition: every form field has a label
findings.remediation: Give each field a <label> or an aria-label.
findings.commercial_relevance: Unlabelled fields cannot be filled in with a screen reader.

findings.title: Forms submit securely
findings.expected_condition: forms are on https pages and submit to https addresses
findings.remediation: Serve form pages over https and point form actions at https addresses.
findings.commercial_relevance: Browsers warn before sending data insecurely, and visitors abandon the form.

findings.title: Consistent phone
findings.expected_condition: the telephone in structured data is one the pages show
findings.remediation: Use the same phone number in structured data, on the pages and in listings.
findings.commercial_relevance: Inconsistent name, address and phone data weakens local rankings and misroutes calls.

findings.title: Distinct titles and descriptions
findings.expected_condition: every analyzed page has a title, and no two pages share a title or description
findings.remediation: Give each page a title and description that say what it offers.
findings.commercial_relevance: Duplicated metadata makes pages compete with each other in search results.

findings.title: Short forms
findings.expected_condition: lead forms ask for at most 7 fields (12 is a warning)
findings.remediation: Ask only for what is needed to reply; leave the rest for the follow-up.
findings.commercial_relevance: Every extra field lowers the share of visitors who send the form.

findings.title: Locations page
findings.observed_value: the pages show one location or none
findings.expected_condition: a site that shows several addresses has a page for its locations
findings.remediation: Give each location its own page, or list every address on a locations page.
findings.commercial_relevance: Location pages let each branch rank for its own area.

findings.title: Language versions linked
findings.observed_value: the analyzed pages are in one language
findings.expected_condition: a site with Spanish and English pages declares hreflang alternates
findings.remediation: Add hreflang links between the language versions of each page.
findings.commercial_relevance: Search engines can then show Spanish speakers the Spanish page.
